adjudication_note: The draw against 2.14.1 (seed 41077) found two errors and both are traceable to a repair rather than to an old defect: `índices P/L` because the P/E concept was registered in the singular only, and `distribuição de dividendos` because narrowing entity.distribution to the placement of fund shares — itself a correct fix — left the payout sense with nowhere to go. A correction that exposes the next gap is the loop working.

concepts.def: The payment of earnings to holders, a taxable event for a closed-end fund holder.
